invention.ref: James Mease published an early American tomato ketchup recipe; this is documentary evidence, not a proven first invention
invention.ref_zh: 詹姆斯·米斯发表美国早期番茄酱配方；此为文献节点，并非已证实的首次发明

mass_production.ref: Heinz introduced its bottled tomato ketchup in the United States, a commercial milestone rather than the origin of tomato ketchup
mass_production.ref_zh: 亨氏在美国推出瓶装番茄酱；这是商品化节点，不是番茄酱的起源

locations.place_label_zh: 美国宾夕法尼亚州费城（米斯1812年配方记载）
美国（亨氏瓶装番茄酱上市，1876；国家级近似定位）
locations.place_label_en: United States (Heinz bottled ketchup launch, 1876; approximate national location)

sources.title: The Birth of Non-Alcoholic Ketchup — Smithsonian Magazine
Heinz Tomato Ketchup Bottle, circa 1903 — The Henry Ford

notes: 本条指番茄制成的餐桌调味酱，不涵盖早期鱼露、蘑菇或核桃ketchup，也不等同浓缩番茄膏。1812年是早期配方记载，1876年仅为亨氏产品上市。
notes_en: This entry covers tomato ketchup, not earlier fish, mushroom, or walnut sauces, nor tomato paste. 1812 is an early recipe record; 1876 is a Heinz product launch.
summary_zh: 番茄酱是以番茄为主体的餐桌调味酱，区别于早期鱼类或蘑菇制成的ketchup。1812年米斯留下早期配方记载；1876年亨氏推出瓶装产品，并非由该品牌首次发明番茄酱。
summary_en: Tomato ketchup differs from earlier fish or mushroom sauces. Mease published an early recipe in 1812; Heinz launched bottled ketchup in 1876, rather than inventing the food type.
